newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London lower in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London lower in thin trade.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks were slightly lower following a weak finish in Hong Kong overnight but trading volumes were light ahead of the New Year holiday, dealers said.
"The market is dead. We're just waiting to go home," one trader said.
In Hong Kong on Tuesday, the Hang Seng ended a half-day session 29.30 points lower at 13,451.45. The Hang Seng London Reference index was down 1.25 points at 13,450.20 by 1035 GMT.
The London share markets close at 1230 GMT on Tuesday and reopen on Thursday, January 2.
